# env-facts — DSH plugin: structured environment facts with an as-of stamp

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Host plugin that adds a machine-readable fact block with its
capture time t
o the runtime-context snapshot:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The built-in snapshot lists these facts as prose and carries no timestamp; this plugin adds
both a s
tructured form and an `As of` time without touching the DSH installation.
## Why the as-of stamp is computed this way

The snapshot text participates in DSH's dedupe: while the environment is stable the snapshot
is **no

t re-sent** (an audit of `dsh-v0.2.1-rc.3` measured 186 model steps producing a single
snapshot). Wr

iting a fresh timestamp every step would defeat that dedupe and emit one message
per step.

This plugin caches per session and only recomputes the text when the facts change. `As of` is
the mo

ment those facts last changed (or were first captured), so the text stays byte-identical
while the e
nvironment is stable and the snapshot dedupe keeps working.
## Facts and their sources
| Field | Source |

| `cwd` | `workingDirectory.get(session)` |
| `file_policy` | `sandboxPolicy.resolve({ session }).mo

de` |
| `approval_policy` | `approval.overrideOf(session)` (omitted when unset) |
| `gui_url` | `web

App.getAdvertisedUrl()` |
| `session` | `session.id` |
A missing service or fact is simply omitted; it never fails assembly.
## Install

Install the package directory as a local bundle with `plugin_manager` (`install_bundle`).
The packag
e declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, which inserts the `env-facts` row.
## `upstream-patch/`

This directory contains two patches against `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` tag
`dsh-v0.2.1-rc.3` tha

t move the same idea into the core (snapshot header constant + stamp at
emission, dedupe by body). T

hey are provided for reference and for the upstream project; see
`upstream-patch/PR.md`.
